note: Production static export generated from processed NASA Earth Engine DEM, MODIS, and TerraClimate datasets.

characteristics.name: Topography
characteristics.description: Slope, roughness, and local relief — primary safety and construction constraint.

characteristics.name: Geology
characteristics.description: Lithology and regolith analog — indicates construction material and surface chemistry.

characteristics.name: Thermal
characteristics.description: Temperature extremes and daily range — hardware stress and thermal management.

characteristics.name: Aridity
characteristics.description: Aridity and liquid-water absence — REQUIREMENT: score rewards proximity to maximum aridity.

characteristics.name: Ice and Polar
characteristics.description: Ground ice, permafrost, and polar light regime — in-situ water resource and polar environment.

characteristics.name: Volcanic Terrain and Caves
characteristics.description: Volcanic terrain and lava-tube proxy — natural shelter from radiation and thermal extremes.

characteristics.name: Surface Optics
characteristics.description: Albedo and dust — affects imaging, thermal balance, and surface operations.

characteristics.name: Illumination
characteristics.description: Solar elevation regime — LOW SUN analog for lunar south pole; latitude-driven for Mars.
